title: Filtering the sales table by numbers · part 23

steps.title: Filter then sort: total != 99.7
steps.prompt:

steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total != 99.7 ORDER BY total LIMIT 3;

Add WHERE total != 99.7.

steps.memory_trick: WHERE trims, ORDER BY sorts, LIMIT cuts.
